tasks.title: IMO Belux and France PF Sale Impact
tasks.emailBlurb:
THE ASK · Alex needs comprehensive EBITDA analysis for Belux/France covering 2025 monthly actuals, 2026 monthly budget and actuals with weather adjustments. Kabir, Scott Romanoff, and Mike Esposito are collaborating on tax treatment of cash distributions, requiring LTM calculations (Dec 2025 rolling to July 2026) and distributable cash modeling at constant leverage to validate the 1.2-2M Euro valuation under the competing indicative offers.
CONTEXT · This flows from the July IMO France divestiture process where AMAVI submitted a 1.2-2M Euro EBITDA indicative offer for Belux & France. Lock box discussions with bidders occurred late July (July 30-31), with Kabir and Alex leading buyer engagement. The EBITDA definition in the offers now requires validation against actual monthly operating performance and proper tax structuring for distributions.
SUGGESTED PLAN
1. Compile monthly actual EBITDA for Belux and France for all 2025 and 2026 YTD (through July 2026)
2. Obtain and apply 2026 monthly budget EBITDA to calculate actuals-versus-budget variance
3. Determine weather normalization adjustments with operations and apply to monthly EBITDA figures
4. Calculate Dec 2025 LTM EBITDA (12 months ended Dec 31, 2025)
5. Roll forward to July 2026 LTM EBITDA (12 months ended July 31, 2026)
6. Confirm target leverage ratio and debt covenant requirements with Kabir and Scott
7. Calculate distributable cash at constant leverage using the LTM metrics, incorporating Mike Esposito's tax treatment guidance
1. finalize france locked box 2. france purchae price and mutiplle, and ebitda monthly, post tax include F&E, 3. do same for Belux, lookinto pay down tax and earnings 4. look into cash distribution to HPS and debt paydown
